pages.text: Fertilizers are used to add nutrients to $(l:agriculture/growing_crops)crops$(). $(item)$(k:key.use)$() with a fertilizer in your hand on some $(thing)Farmland$(), $(l:agriculture/greenhouse#planters)Planter$() or a $(thing)Crop$() to add the nutrients. Particles should appear, indicating the fertilizer was added.$(br)You can find nutrient information in a fertilizers' tooltip. The next few pages list some available fertilizers.
